leader.name: Leader
leader.html: Before the battle, a CHARACTER model with this ability can be attached to one of the units listed on its datasheet to form an Attached unit. Only one Leader can be attached to a unit (unless a rule says otherwise). While attached, the Leader and its Bodyguard unit are treated as a single unit; attacks cannot be allocated to the Leader while any Bodyguard models remain, unless a rule (such as [PRECISION]) allows it.

extra attacks.name: Extra Attacks
extra attacks.html: Weapons with [EXTRA ATTACKS] in their profile are known as Extra Attacks weapons. Each time the bearer fights, it makes attacks with this weapon in addition to the attacks it makes with its other melee weapons. The number of attacks made with an Extra Attacks weapon cannot be modified by other rules.

fights first.name: Fights First
fights first.html: Units with this ability that are eligible to fight do so in the Fights First step of the Fight phase, provided every model in the unit has this ability.

hazardous.name: Hazardous
hazardous.html: Weapons with [HAZARDOUS] in their profile are known as Hazardous weapons. After a unit shoots or fights with such weapons, roll one D6 for each Hazardous weapon used: for each 1, one model equipped with that weapon is destroyed (CHARACTER, MONSTER and VEHICLE models suffer 3 mortal wounds instead).

lance.name: Lance
lance.html: Weapons with [LANCE] in their profile are known as Lance weapons. Each time an attack is made with such a weapon, if the bearer made a Charge move this turn, add 1 to that attack’s Wound roll.

invulnerable save.name: Invulnerable Save
invulnerable save.html: A save that is never modified by the Armour Penetration characteristic of an attack. When making a saving throw, use either the model’s Save or its invulnerable save — whichever is better.

parts.label: When
parts.html: In any phase, just after you make an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test or a Hazardous test for a unit from your army, or a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, or a roll to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon equipped by a model in that unit.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: That unit or model from your army.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Your unit fights next.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Fight phase, when a CHARACTER unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more Attached units is selected to fight.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One CHARACTER model in your unit.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, all melee attacks made by that model have the [PRECISION] ability.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just after you have failed a Battle-shock test taken for a unit from your army.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: The unit from your army that Battle-shock test was taken for (even though your models are Battle-shocked).

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Your unit is treated as having passed that test instead, and is not Battle-shocked as a result.

parts.label: Restriction
parts.html: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Shooting phase.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One GRENADES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Select one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army and is within 8" of and visible to your GRENADES unit. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Charge phase.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One VEHICLE unit from your army.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, after your unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it, then select one model in your unit to be the Tank Shock model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the Toughness characteristic of that model. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

parts.label: When
parts.html: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One unit from your army that is in Reserves.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Your unit can arrive on the battlefield as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.

parts.label: Restriction
parts.html: You cannot use this Stratagem to enable a unit to arrive on the battlefield during a battle round it would not normally be able to do so in.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Movement or Charge phase, just after an enemy unit is set up, or when an enemy unit starts or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, or declares a charge.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One unit from your army that is within 24" of that enemy unit and that would be eligible to shoot if it were your Shooting phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: If that enemy unit is visible to your unit, your unit can shoot that enemy unit as if it were your Shooting phase. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon’s Ballistic Skill or any modifiers.

parts.label: Restriction
parts.html: You cannot target a TITANIC unit with this Stratagem. You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have a 6+ invulnerable save and have the Benefit of Cover.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One SMOKE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One unit from your army that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Your unit now declares a charge that targets only that enemy unit, and you resolve that charge as if it were your Charge phase.

parts.label: Restriction
parts.html: You can only select a VEHICLE unit from your army if it is a WALKER. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.
